title: Main Character
prompt_text: # Main Character Mode: Interactive Life-Sim Social Post (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive 4:5 social-media post in the style of a life-simulation game. A stylish young woman sits on an invisible chair on a bright green hill under a clear blue sky. A green rotating crystal gem floats above her head, and cream pill-shaped action bubbles fan out around her like a game pie menu: "Gossip", "Flirt", "Change Outfit", "Ask About Mood", "Talk About Pet", "More Choices…". The woman subtly comes alive in a looping video. Each bubble triggers its own effect: - floating hearts - a speech bubble with gibberish - a sparkle-swirl outfit change - a mood panel - a thought bubble - a second page of choices Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Main Character Mode`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@700;800;900&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the three latin woff2 faces (Nunito 700/800/900) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead of the link. - **CSS variables:** `--navy:#1f3f8f`, `--pill1:#fffaf4`, `--pill2:#f3e9de`, `--sky:#3f8fd8`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height with `overflow:hidden` and background `#3d86cf`. - body font `"Nunito","Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif`, antialiased, `user-select:none`. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) 1. **Idle loop video (Kling 4.0, 5.04 s, 24 fps, 1288×1608, 4:5, no audio):** a static camera; she breathes, slowly turns her head to the camera with a slight smile, then turns back to look off to the side; a breeze ripples the grass and her curls. The first frame equals the last frame, so it loops seamlessly. `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261106_062821_b3d651fe-7fbe-4e60-b4f5-77b953e1d1ce.mp4` 2. **Scene still and poster (GPT Image 2.5, 1792×2240, 4:5):** a bright gradient blue sky with fine film grain and a lush green grass hill sloping down from the left. A young woman with short dark curly hair and gold hoops sits on an invisible chair, one knee raised, hands on the knee, looking off to her right. She wears an oversized pastel-yellow and white striped short-sleeve shirt, wide-leg cream trousers and plain white chunky sneakers. Two patches of red flowers sit in the grass, and a long soft shadow falls to the right. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062711_9bf7546c-1db2-4093-97d4-0e32ea8d2abd.png&w=1800&q=86` 3. **Second outfit still (same frame, pixel-aligned):** a cropped cobalt-blue bomber jacket over a white tee, baggy light-wash jeans and chunky red sneakers. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062819_17105efe-2915-4316-bf1a-e0df5aaf09f5.png&w=1800&q=86` 4. **Icon sticker sheet (transparent PNG, glossy cartoon icons, treated as a 1300×735 frame).** Eight icons in a 4×2 grid: - lips at (185,225) - pink heart at (492,225) - blue cap at (795,225) - two speech bubbles ("chat") at (1115,225) - white puppy ("dog") at (175,500) - laughing face ("laugh") at (495,500) - gold four-point star at (797,505) - purple music note at (1102,500) `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062315_19b00fc8-cf66-4329-9c8f-9a6b05569d1a.png&w=1300&q=90` **Icon sprite helper `icon(el,key)`:** cell size c=210. Set the background-image to the sheet, `background-size: (1300/c*100)% (735/c*100)%`, and `background-position: ((cx-c/2)/(1300-c)*100)% ((cy-c/2)/(735-c)*100)%`. ## 3. Layout - **Backdrop:** a fixed `.backdrop` at inset -8% shows the poster image `center/cover`, with `filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.1)` and `scale(1.05)`. - **Card `#scene`:** absolutely centred (translate -50%,-50%), overflow hidden, shadow `0 30px 80px rgba(10,40,80,.35)`. - **Sizing (JS, on load and on resize):** `w = min(innerWidth, innerHeight*.8)`, `h = w*1.25`, and `font-size = w/100` px, so **1em = 1% of the card width**. Everything inside uses card % and em. - CSS variable `--hx: 51.6%` (her head's x). - **Stacking order inside the card:** 1. `
